transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for making time for this pre-purchase review. As you know, we're considering the vendor's indoor-air-quality monitoring system for the science wing. The preliminary discussion has focused on the six-monitor package at $3,100, though the vendor also offers a nine-monitor package at $4,320. Before I can give final approval, we need to complete our routine review — facilities check, funding review, and health review. Let's go around the table. Could we start with the facilities assessment of the science wing?

transcript.text: I completed my facilities inspection of the science wing this week. I found nine separate classrooms that each need a monitor because they have independent ventilation zones. The room-by-room report hasn't been entered into the purchasing worksheet yet, but based on my inspection, we need the nine-monitor package, not the six-monitor one.
